title: The first records with Kid Ory for the Spikes brothers
summary: How the first Black New Orleans band recordings were made in 1923 for the Spikes brothers, with singers, in a studio near Santa Monica.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: tell us a little about those first records that you made with Ori. Now, how did that come about?
The first records we made with Ori?
That was the first record that any Negro band ever made, right?
Well, that was for Red Spikes. Johnny Spikes and Red Spikes. Were you working in Los Angeles
We were in Frisco. You were in Frisco? In Oakland. In Oakland.
just to make the records? It was in Oakland, 1923.

We were working in Oakland. We were working in Oakland. We come down here to make those records. We made them out there in the Santa Monica. We were out there somewhere. Where was the studio? Out on Pico Street. You know, we were out there. Towards the beach? Yeah. Out there. Where is that studio out there? 20th Century Fox? Yeah.
